pick.headline: Riots erupt in Dushanbe
pick.summary: In mid-February 1990 rioting broke out in Dushanbe, the capital of Soviet Tajikistan, over rumours that Armenian refugees would be given housing; a state of emergency was imposed.
pick.significance: The unrest, which left over twenty dead, showed ethnic tensions spreading to Soviet Central Asia.
